verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core design is autonomous agents/crews/flows that execute tasks independently, with CLI commands to run/deploy crews, enterprise deployment to managed infra, webhook streaming, and a real-world community example (Gmail automation agent) running unattended with scheduled/background behavior via kickoff hooks. missing for 10: independent verification of true background/scheduled (cron-like) execution outside enterprise product, and more third-party confirmation beyond one community project.
